Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that, because NIDA is affiliated with/has degrees accredited by UNSW, the correct institute should be the University of New South Wales. This conflated the accrediting university with the actual institute attended. Mel Gibson attended the National Institute of Dramatic Art (NIDA), not UNSW, so this pivot led toward the wrong final answer.
